claim: Auction rules: adequate notice to the borrower before the auction; a reserve price of at least 90% of the collateral's current value (85% after two failed auctions); any surplus refunded within seven working days of receiving the full auction proceeds.

notes: Regulator's text. HEDGES for the script: (1) the rule is a RESERVE price (the minimum acceptable), not a 'starting price' (ch.6).
